# The Knocking

> **[COLOR GRADE]**
> Color grade: Murky blue-black night, sickly green-white camera light, crushed shadows, grainy camcorder noise.

## SHOT 1 — Lakeside Camp (0:00–0:04)

**[STILL]** A wide shot of a dusk lakeside campsite filmed from a hand-held position, slightly tilted. A small orange tent sits off-centre on the right, a half-burnt campfire smoulders in front of it, and the black lake lies behind under a dim purple sky. Mia, a young woman in a grey hoodie and beanie with her face half out of frame, grins at the lens at the left edge. Nothing else is visible.

**[MOTION]** The operator swings the camera from the lake to the tent, then turns it around onto Mia as she waves. The picture jitters as the operator walks. The light is fading fast.

**[CHARACTERS]** Mia

**[DIALOGUE]** Mia: "Day one, last light. Nobody out here for miles. Perfect."

**[SFX]** Lapping water, crackling embers, a crow somewhere, cloth rustling against the microphone.

**[BEAT]** hook

## SHOT 2 — First Knock (0:04–0:09)

**[STILL]** A close-up inside the tent at night, lit only by a small camera-mounted light. Mia's pale face fills the bottom of the frame, eyes wide and cut off at the forehead. Behind her, the orange tent wall has a single dark hand-shaped smudge on the inside of the fabric, high up, where no one was sitting.

**[MOTION]** The camera is pressed close to Mia in her sleeping bag. She freezes and holds her breath. The operator slowly tilts the lens up toward the smudge. A single knock sounds from the inside of the tent wall, and the fabric flexes outward slightly.

**[CHARACTERS]** Mia

**[DIALOGUE]** Mia: "That's... that was inside. That was on the inside."

**[SFX]** Held breath, a dull knuckle knock on fabric, a zipper ticking in the wind, distant water.

**[BEAT]** build

## SHOT 3 — Two (0:09–0:14)

**[STILL]** A wide shot of the tent interior in harsh camera light. Mia is crouched against the left wall, her hood up and face turned away. Through the mesh window of the tent door at the right, a tall, thin, pale figure stands motionless far out among the black tree trunks, its head too high, its face an empty smear.

**[MOTION]** The camera whips from Mia to the mesh window, shaking. Two knocks land close together on the tent wall beside Mia's shoulder. She scrambles back, hand slapping the lens edge. The operator keeps the light fixed on the distant trees.

**[CHARACTERS]** Mia

**[DIALOGUE]** Mia: "Two. It's counting. It's counting, it's getting closer."

**[SFX]** Two sharp knocks, a rustle of sleeping bag, ragged breathing, a branch snapping outside.

**[BEAT]** build

## SHOT 4 — Three (0:14–0:19)

**[STILL]** A medium shot through the half-open tent flap into the dark campsite, the camera light a weak cone. The pale, thin figure now stands at the edge of the dead fire, thirty feet away, arms hanging too long at its sides, face turned toward the lens but never clear. Mia's shaking hand holding a phone is cut off at the left edge.

**[MOTION]** The operator leans out and pushes the light into the dark, then stops dead. Three slow knocks sound behind the camera, from the inside of the tent. Mia swings the lens around and the picture blurs. The light flickers.

**[CHARACTERS]** Mia

**[DIALOGUE]** Mia: "Three. Oh my God, it's behind me. Don't look, don't look."

**[SFX]** Three slow knocks, a sharp inhale, a flickering electrical buzz from the camera light.

**[BEAT]** build

## SHOT 5 — Four (0:19–0:23)

**[STILL]** A tilted close shot of Mia's back as she tears open the tent zipper, the camera light glaring on grey fabric. Outside, in the mud ten feet away, the tall pale figure stands on the edge of the light, its neck bent at an angle, its face a blank oval with something dark at the mouth.

**[MOTION]** Mia dives through the opening, the camera bouncing wildly. The light catches the figure for half a second. It is already gone, and the frame jerks to empty trees. Four knocks pound the tent behind her, hard.

**[CHARACTERS]** Mia

**[DIALOGUE]** Mia: "Run! Run, run, run!"

**[SFX]** Zipper ripping, boots in mud, four heavy knocks, panicked breathing.

**[BEAT]** build

## SHOT 6 — Five (0:23–0:27)

**[STILL]** A tilted wide shot of the dark forest path, the camera light barely reaching. Mia's back runs ahead, partly out of frame, hood bouncing. Right behind her, four feet from the lens, the tall pale figure stands in the light, head tilted, long fingers hanging beside its legs, face still a smear.

**[MOTION]** The camera swings to look behind it as the operator runs. The figure is closer than before and has not moved a limb. Five knocks hit a tree trunk beside the camera. Mia screams and the picture spins.

**[CHARACTERS]** Mia

**[DIALOGUE]** Mia: "Stop filming! Put it down — it's right there!"

**[SFX]** Pounding footsteps, five loud knocks on wood, a scream, gasping.

**[BEAT]** payoff

## SHOT 7 — Six (0:27–0:30)

**[STILL]** A close-up looking up from the ground at a tilted angle, the camera lying in dead leaves with its light failing. A long, pale, gaunt face fills the frame inches from the lens, the eyes two black holes, the mouth stretched open, bending down over the camera.

**[MOTION]** The camera hits the ground and rolls to a stop on its side. A long pale hand reaches into frame toward the lens. The light dims to a dull orange glow, then dies. Hard cut to black.

**[CHARACTERS]** Mia

**[SFX]** The thud of impact, a final single knock on the lens, Mia's scream cut off, silence.

**[BEAT]** cta
